tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: For Group A, the bidder or OEM shall have experience in supply, installation and maintenance of multi-function printers to Government Departments or PSUs in India.For Group B, the bidder or OEM shall have experience in supply, installation and maintenance of desktop computers to Government Departments or PSUs in India.
Bidder / OEM shall be engaged in the business of supply, installation and maintenance of multi-function printers and/or desktop computers in India, as applicable to the Group(s) quoted.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Registration or incorporation certificate and evidence of business activity.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Group A - For Printers - supply, installation and maintenance of at least five MFPs within the last five years and either one similar work greater than or equal to Rs.16,00,000, or two similar works greater than or equal to Rs.10,00,000 each, or three similar works greater than or equal to Rs.8,00,000 each. For Group B - For Desktop Computers - supply, installation and maintenance of at least twenty desktop computers within the last five years and either one similar work greater than or equal to Rs.8,00,000, or two similar works greater than or equal to Rs.6,00,000 each, or three similar works greater than or equal to Rs.4,00,000 each.

In case of authorized representative/dealer of a manufacturer - The manufacturer furnishes authorization in the prescribed format assuring full guarantee and warranty obligations as per General Conditions of Contract and Special Conditions of Contract. Manufacturers Authorization Form to be provided as per Section XIII of Tender Document.
Average annual turnover shall be not less than Rs.20,00,000 during FY 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 MSME bidders: Rs.10,00,000 or applicable threshold as permitted by Government instructions.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The equipments offered for supply must be of the most recent series models incorporating the latest improvements in design. The models should have been released on or after 2024.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Confirmation through OEM document on release of the model

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder shall have technical support / service facility in Karnataka with at least 3 service engineers / staff and an office in Karnataka, preferably Bengaluru.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Service centre details and Annexure E technical staff details.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder shall not have been blacklisted/debarred by Government of Karnataka or its agencies, nor by Central/other State or UT Government agencies for corrupt, fraudulent or unfair trade practices.
A detailed description of the essential technical and performance characteristics of the goods.
Item-wise technical compliance statement shall be submitted.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Annexure I duly completed and signed.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Technical documents and product brochure for the exact offered model shall be submitted.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- OEM technical brochure or datasheet and working principle document.
